# Compress the Sydney photographs directory into a tar file
sydney_dir = '/home/kristin/photographs/vacations/sydney/'
tar_path = '/home/kristin/photographs/vacations/sydney.tar'

# If tar already exists, we won't overwrite (overwrite default false)
exists_before = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=tar_path)
print('tar_exists_before', exists_before)

if not exists_before.get('exists', False):
    comp_res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        directory_path=sydney_dir,
        access_token=fs_token,
        compressed_file_path=tar_path
    )
    print('compress_result', comp_res)
else:
    comp_res = {'message':'already_exists'}

exists_after = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=tar_path)
print('tar_exists_after', exists_after)

sibling_emails = ['eri_powe@gmail.com','jepowell@gmail.com','mir-powe@gmail.com']
sydney_tar = '/home/kristin/photographs/vacations/sydney.tar'

# Send one email with all siblings as recipients and attach the tar file
send_res = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=sibling_emails,
    subject='Sydney trip photographs',
    body='Hi! I compiled all of my Sydney trip photographs into the attached tar file. Love, Kristin.',
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[sydney_tar],
    file_system_access_token=fs_token
)
print(send_res)

tar_exists_check = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path='/home/kristin/photographs/vacations/sydney.tar')
print('tar_exists_check', tar_exists_check)

# Complete the task (no answer needed; it's an action)
res_complete = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print('complete_task', res_complete)
